name: Mesh/Point Cloud Evaluation Metrics
definition: Computes comprehensive mesh quality metrics including Chamfer Distance (CD), Normal Consistency (NC), F1 score, Edge Chamfer Distance (ECD), Edge F1 (EF1), aspect ratio, radius ratio, angle regularity, and self-intersection percentage.
summary: Mesh/Point Cloud Evaluation Metrics provide a holistic assessment of geometric fidelity and mesh validity, distinguishing themselves by combining distance-based accuracy with shape-based quality indicators like aspect ratios and self-intersection counts.
